case_title: Narender Singh & Ors. v. State of Madhya Pradesh
trial_court_outcome: Convicted and sentenced to life imprisonment
neutral_facts: The prosecution case is that on 27th June 1997 at 10:00 p.m., the victim was sitting and conversing with P.W.3 and another individual at a location near a hotel. The accused arrived at the scene, among whom one held a sword, another a Farsa, another an axe, and others had lathis. The accused attacked the victim with the weapons, causing him to fall down. The victim's injuries were noted by medical examination and post-mortem reports. The accused were arrested and charged with murder and other offenses. The trial court convicted the accused of murder and sentenced them to life imprisonment. The High Court upheld the conviction. The Supreme Court confirmed the conviction and sentence, finding the prosecution's case supported by eyewitness accounts, medical evidence, and other material evidence.
